name: review-loop
description: A bounded review → fix → re-review loop over one pull request, with stop rules taken from runs that went wrong. Never merges.

review_gates.title: Review gate command
review_gates.description: Shell command that must pass before and after every review round, e.g. 'pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build'. Leave empty to read the gates from the repository's CLAUDE.md.

review_command.title: Review command
review_command.description: How this project runs a code review.
